name: What is the best type of paint to use for a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What is the best type of paint to use for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: For bathrooms, a satin or semi-gloss finish is recommended. These finishes are more durable, easier to clean, and offer better resistance to moisture and mildew compared to matte or eggshell paints. Look for paints specifically formulated for high-humidity areas, as they contain additives that inhibit mold and mildew growth. Using a primer designed for damp environments can also enhance durability and adhesion, ensuring your paint lasts longer in a bathroom setting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Satin or semi-gloss paints are best for bathrooms due to their moisture resistance and durability.
